note: Fresh deploy 2026-11-07: the deployer wallet receives the whole supply (1,000,000,000 RNG = 10^15 atoms) in one allocation. The runbook then moves 200,000,000 RNG into the beacon reserve (X-Foundation) and 50,000,000 into its treasury (X-Treasury), under the beacon's owners (the wallet and the RNG DAO), and bonds validatorRng for each launch validator. The rest stays with the deployer for seeding the RNG/PUSD book and the swarm.
